selection_rule: Before outcomes: first clean full UTC Mon-Fri week wholly in April, then May, then June 2025; independently first clean full week in August 2025. Audit 200 actual preceding warmup rows and week edges. Retain all refusals. No PnL-based window choice.
execution: existing next modeled open; prior completed-bar signal/context; unchanged modeled spread, commission, slippage, gap and carry rules; zero observed BID/ASK coverage
gate: range_low_v1 requires actual closed-row market_regime=range and volatility_regime=low_volatility; missing/unknown means WAIT. This is a curator hypothesis, not an author rule or a proven label.
analysis_boundary: Account paths, sizing and cooldowns may differ. These are whole-account policy contrasts, not identical-entry isolated trade effects. Two weeks in different months are discovery coverage, not independent validation. Six/twenty-four observed M5 rows are nominal thirty/one-hundred-twenty minutes, not a day-flat guarantee.

budgets.deadlines: both UTC and monotonic; no renewal

terminal_rules: Keep completed, technical and unattempted cases distinct; missing evidence stays unknown, not zero. Reinspection performs no replay. No outcome-dependent retry or parameter change in this question.
exposure: Reused historical archive; complete prior training/selection/warmup/context exposure inventory is unavailable. No untouched claim.
